title: Shoots popcorn kernels and popcorn all over the place. Makes a mess.
text: Shoots popcorn kernels and popcorn all over the place. Makes a mess.. I was disappointed that this popcorn maker shoots popcorn kernels and popcorn all over the place. After making a batch of popcorn you have to search all over the kitchen counters and floor for stray popcorn kernels. Also, the popcorn flavor is not great (I'm using a new container of Orville Redenbacher premium popcorn), it tastes kind of dry and overheated.

description: Best hot air popper! Convenient, natural and light! Pops regular or gourmet popping corn with hot air, not oil, for a healthy, low calorie treat ! Fast! Pops up to 18 cups of gourmet corn in less than 2 1/2 minutes. Leaves virtually no un-popped kernels. Endorsed by Orville Redenbacher. 120 volts, 60 Hz only

Plug in the Orville Redenbacher Hot Air Corn Popper and the party begins. In less than 2-1/2 minutes you’ll have up to 18 cups--two large bowlfuls--of fluffy popcorn with virtually no unpopped kernels. And because the machine uses hot air instead of oil, the resulting snack is healthier and lower in calories. That’s not to say you can’t add butter; in fact, the 1/2-cup measuring cup on top of the popper doubles as a butter melter. Simply put in the desired amount of margarine or butter (room temperature is best), and it melts from the heat produced during the popping process. The clear plastic cover and cup, which must stay on during popping so the popped corn doesn’t fly all over the room, easily remove for hand cleaning with warm, soapy water. No other clean-up is required. While a few unpopped kernels spring out the chute as the machine begins to heats up, the chute does a good job of directing the popped corn into a bowl. The popper measures 14 by 9 by 6-1/2 inches, and is identical to Presto’s PopLite Hot Air Corn Popper except for color and logo. Presto covers the popper with a 1 year limited warranty.
